comment: Population growth (stage 4F, ADR 0020, GDD 5.2): every year a fed, healthy settlement gains births × (1 − child mortality) − adult deaths per thousand; births rise by moodBirthsPerMillePerPoint for every mood point above 50 (fall below); of the people who got no food in a turn starvationDeathPercent die, in a mobile camp campStarvationDeathPercent (hunters scatter and have fewer children instead, 2026-11-08); settled villages have villageDeathsPerMille more adult deaths and villageBirthsPerMille more births (farmers had children at shorter gaps: the Neolithic demographic transition, Bocquet-Appel); technologies change births, child mortality and adult deaths through effects (effects.json). Values from historical data: hunter-gatherers lost about 49% of children before 15 (Volk and Atkinson 2013) and grew about 0.4 per mille a year until 1700 (Our World in Data). Population growth, hunger, health, gathering, wild food, influence zones and migration (GDD 5.2, 5.4, 4.4). wildFood: gathering at full strength removes depletionPerMillePerYear of a cell stock every year; every year a cell grows back regrowthPercentPerYear of what is missing. influence: range in movement cost, baseRange plus one per warriorsPerRange warriors. homeCost: the cells a settlement reaches for at most this cost (its own cell always) are its home ground and belong to it before any zone that is not home ground there, so farmers cannot squeeze a band off the land it lives on (2026-11-08). migration: rules of the simple tribe AI used until Stage 4 (moves at most every minStepsBetweenMoves own steps of its civilization; a new camp needs land that feeds splitNeedsFoodPercent of the leaving group; tiny camps below mergeBelowPeople join a camp of their own; attackAboveStrengthPercent: the AI attacks a camp in its way only with that much of the defenders' strength). comfort: how pleasant a place is to live in, for the tribe AI: below coldBelow or above hotAbove (°C; the season's temperature when seasons are live, otherwise the winter temperature) a place loses percentPerDegree of its value per degree, down to minPercent; the cold_tolerance effect (fire, clothing, houses from technologies) moves the cold limit down. conquest: migration with conquest, simplified until wars in Stage 4 (GDD 5.4): defenders' strength is their warriors plus defenderNonWarriorPercent of everyone else; the winners lose winnerWarriorLossPercent of their warriors, the losers loserWarriorLossPercent; expelled people lose fleeingLossPercent while fleeing. gathering.survivableDeadSeasonYears: the longest dead season (no plant growth, in Earth years) gatherers live through without losing food; longer winters (long planet years) cut wild food in proportion, until technologies raise it. All rates are per year and converted by the length of the civilization's own step (ADR 0018). Per mille = parts per thousand. Values are first guesses for tuning with Patryk. farming (stage 3f, GDD 4.4): producers of a settled village farm the fertile land cells of its zone (fertility at least minFertility), at most farmersPerCell on a cell, best land first; a farmer grows grainPerFarmerPerYear × (50 + fertility) / 100 × the share of the year plants grow (the same rule as wild food). Farmed land loses exhaustionPerYear fertility points a year at full work; land left alone regains recoveryPerYear points a year up to its natural fertility. Producers who do not farm gather.
